evidence_items.finding: annual revenue has declined from $2.9M to $2.2M over two years — a 24% decline
evidence_items.rationale: 24% revenue decline over two years is a critical adverse financial health signal. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: gross margin has compressed from 28% to 18% over the same two-year period — an independent deterioration from the revenue decline
evidence_items.rationale: Gross margin compression from 28% to 18% occurring simultaneously with revenue decline suggests two separate causes. financial_health; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner has not tracked project-level margins and cannot identify which project types or client relationships are driving each decline
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of project-level margin tracking preventing diagnosis of the cause of either decline is a critical adverse process signal. process_maturity; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: the owner generates all new business through personal consultations and has had fewer available hours for consultations as operations have demanded more time
evidence_items.rationale: Owner serving as the sole business development resource while operational demands increase is an adverse capacity signal. operational_efficiency; is_critical=true.

evidence_items.finding: building renovation; revenue $2.9M to $2.2M; margin 28% to 18%; no project margin tracking; owner sole business developer; input costs not tracked
Surface signal (not root cause): the building materials sector has seen broad cost increases in the period — giving a plausible external explanation for margin pressure
evidence_items.rationale: Industry-wide materials cost increases are a misleading signal that they explain this specific margin compression — without project-level data the attribution cannot be confirmed.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the revenue decline coincided with a broader residential renovation market slowdown in the region
evidence_items.rationale: A market-wide slowdown is a misleading signal that it explains this business's revenue decline — without project pipeline data the cause cannot be attributed to market conditions alone.

validation_notes: SIM-12-001 is SUPPORTED via margin_erosion as primary archetype. Mixed-cause: margin compression is the primary supported signal. Revenue decline may map to demand_generation_failure as secondary. No must_identify vocabulary.
